Quality Seeker +1: Provides a +1 Quality bonus to confirm critical hits, and a +1 Quality bonus to critical hit damage (before multipliers are applied).
Insightful Assassinate +3: +3 Insight bonus to the DC of character's Assassinate attempts.
Use Magic Device +2: Passive: +2 Competence bonus to the Use Magic Device skill.
Mythic Trinket Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
